I wasn't quite sure what to expect, and usually I avoid patronizing companies that advertise on social media – – that can be a slippery and often disappointing slope – – but what can I say, I'm a grown man who still likes miniatures and so forth and I was curious. And I have to say, the results have been mostly good to superb. I feel some guilt using an AI model generator, but I can't argue with the results. Because you are dealing with AI you have to be prepared for some degree of frustration, as well. You will get some very strange, very surreal results at times, even if you have input high-quality images with multiple views. But the amount of times it gets things right is significantly higher than the amount of times it gets things wrong. Anyway, I'm very impressed. I sent the STL files to a freelance 3D printer and he commented how impressed he was with how good the files were.
